description: Grafana board for the freebox exporter https://github.com/shackerd/freebox-exporter-rs

panels.description: Model of the box (its hardware revision when the exporter does not give the model), firmware and flavor (full: internal storage, light: none).

targets.expr: fbx_exporter_system_firmware_version{instance="$node", job="$job"} * on (instance, job) group_left (board_name) fbx_exporter_system_board_name{instance="$node", job="$job"} * on (instance, job) group_left (box_flavor) fbx_exporter_system_box_flavor{instance="$node", job="$job"} * on (instance, job) group_left (model_name) fbx_exporter_system_model_info{instance="$node", job="$job"} or on (instance, job) label_replace(fbx_exporter_system_firmware_version{instance="$node", job="$job"} * on (instance, job) group_left (board_name) fbx_exporter_system_board_name{instance="$node", job="$job"} * on (instance, job) group_left (box_flavor) fbx_exporter_system_box_flavor{instance="$node", job="$job"}, "model_name", "$1", "board_name", "(.+)")

panels.title: Box

panels.description: Internet link of the box whatever its media, then the details of the active media: FTTH (SFP) or xDSL. Lines of the other media are not shown.

targets.expr: fbx_exporter_connection_state{instance="$node", job="$job", state="up"} * on (instance, job) group_left (media) fbx_exporter_connection_media{instance="$node", job="$job"} or on (instance, job) fbx_exporter_connection_state{instance="$node", job="$job", state="up"}
fbx_exporter_connection_ftth_sfp_has_signal{instance="$node", job="$job"} and on (instance, job) fbx_exporter_connection_media{instance="$node", job="$job", media="ftth"}
fbx_exporter_connection_ftth_sfp_pwr_rx{instance="$node", job="$job"} / 100 and on (instance, job) fbx_exporter_connection_media{instance="$node", job="$job", media="ftth"}

panels.title: ISP link state

panels.description: Dynamic DNS providers enabled on the box: green ok, orange update in progress, red any other status. Disabled providers are not shown.

targets.expr: (fbx_exporter_ddns_status{instance="$node", job="$job", status="ok"} == 1) or (fbx_exporter_ddns_status{instance="$node", job="$job", status="wait"} == 1) * 2 or (fbx_exporter_ddns_status{instance="$node", job="$job", status!~"ok|wait|disabled"} == 1) * 3

panels.title: DDNS

panels.description: Login of the exporter to the box, and its collectors. While the box refuses the login, the exporter serves no metric of the box: the other panels show nothing. A failed collector keeps exposing its last values: see Exporter health.
panels.title: Exporter

panels.description: Port(s) bandwidth
panels.title: Bandwidth per port

panels.description: Disks seen by the box. Idle for, active for and spin down in are given by the box when available. Read and write errors count failed requests since the start of the box: a growing value may indicate a failing disk.

targets.expr: max by (disk_id, disk_type, model, state) (fbx_exporter_nas_disk_state{instance="$node", job="$job"})

panels.title: Disks

panels.description: Partitions of the disks. Check is the result of the last file system check.

targets.expr: max by (partition_id, disk_id, label, fstype, state) (fbx_exporter_nas_partition_state{instance="$node", job="$job"})

panels.title: Partitions

panels.description: Internal disk of the box, and the partition used for user data (on a light box, a permanently attached external storage).

targets.expr: (fbx_exporter_system_disk_status{instance="$node", job="$job", disk_status="active"} == 1) or (fbx_exporter_system_disk_status{instance="$node", job="$job", disk_status=~"initializing|disabled|not_detected"} == 1) * 2 or (fbx_exporter_system_disk_status{instance="$node", job="$job", disk_status!~"active|initializing|disabled|not_detected"} == 1) * 3

panels.title: Storage

panels.description: Used space of each partition.
panels.title: Partition usage

panels.description: Activity of each disk as given by the box: active, or idle (a spinning disk spins down after some idle time).
panels.title: Disk activity

panels.description: vCPUs given to the virtual machines, over those the box offers them.
panels.title: vCPU allocated

panels.description: Memory given to the virtual machines, over the memory the box offers them.
panels.title: Memory allocated

panels.description: Virtual machines of the box. Requires the VM permission of the application in Freebox OS.

targets.expr: max by (id, name, os, disk_type) (fbx_exporter_vm_info{instance="$node", job="$job"})

panels.title: Virtual machines

panels.description: RAID arrays of the box (raid = true). No array, no line. Last and next checks are absent when never checked or not scheduled.
panels.title: RAID arrays

panels.description: Disks of the RAID arrays. A role other than active or spare, or growing corrected read errors, point to a failing disk.

targets.expr: max by (array_id, id, device_location, role) (fbx_exporter_raid_member_role{instance="$node", job="$job"} == 1)

panels.title: RAID members

panels.description: VPN servers of the box (vpn = true, router mode). Traffic sums the connections currently open: it drops when one closes. User logins and addresses are never exposed.
panels.title: VPN servers

panels.description: VPN client of the box. When it is enabled, its state, last error, rates and last connection are shown, each one when the box returns it.
panels.title: VPN client

panels.description: Sessions open on each VPN server, and those authenticated.
panels.title: VPN connections

panels.description: Throughput of the VPN client of the box, from its transferred bytes. Empty while the client is disabled. The traffic of the VPN servers has no throughput: the box only gives the bytes of the sessions currently open.
panels.title: VPN client throughput

panels.description: One line per collector. A failed collector keeps exposing its last values: trust the panels of a collector only when it is ok. A collector enabled in the configuration but not supported by the box stays failed until the exporter restarts.
panels.title: Collectors

title: freebox-exporter-rs
